summary: XMax Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the approval of salary increases for its CEO, COO, and CFO on July 1, 2026. Annual base salaries were raised: CEO from $80,000 to $160,000, COO from $80,000 to $159,000, and CFO from $70,000 to $80,000. These compensatory arrangements were approved by the Compensation Committee and Board, with amendments to existing employment agreements. No special situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management departures were involved. This is a routine executive compensation update, not a special situation filing.
